subject: Punishment for Murder
note: Punishment substantially retained with death or life imprisonment.

subject: Murder and Exceptions
note: Exceptions including grave and sudden provocation retained.

subject: Culpable Homicide not amounting to murder
note: Retains division between intentional and knowledge-based acts.

subject: Act done by person justified or believing themselves justified by mistake of fact
note: Bona fide belief based on mistake of fact eliminates criminal culpability.

subject: Good Faith (Due care and attention)
note: Requirement of due care and attention strictly preserved.

subject: Unnatural offences
note: No equivalent provision in BNS following constitutional reading down.

subject: Endangering sovereignty, unity and integrity of India
note: Colonial sedition term eliminated; refocused on subversive armed acts.

subject: Defamation
note: Community service introduced as an alternative punishment option.

subject: Sexual Harassment
note: Subsumed into unified Chapter V protecting women and children.

subject: Assault on woman with intent to outrage modesty
Order for maintenance of wives, children and parents
note: Mandatory timeline for interim maintenance applications.

subject: Information in cognizable cases (Zero FIR / e-FIR)
note: Formal statutory recognition of Zero FIR and digital electronic FIRs.

subject: Examination of witnesses by police
note: Expressly allows audio-video recording of statements.

subject: Direction for grant of bail to person apprehending arrest (Anticipatory Bail)
Information received from accused proved in evidence (Discovery)
note: Fact discovered in consequence of information remains admissible.

subject: Admissibility of electronic records
note: Refined electronic certificate mechanisms for modern digital evidence.

subject: Punishment for sending offensive messages through communication service
note: Struck down as unconstitutional in Shreya Singhal (2015); void ab initio.

subject: Findings and reliefs granted by Consumer Commissions
note: Consumer Protection Act 2019 overhauled compensation for deficiency in service.
